speaker: NARRATOR
text: [excited, hushed] What if every time you messed up... you could just... respawn?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [playful] Fall off your bike? Respawn. Spill spaghetti on the principal? Respawn.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [fast, playful] Get hit in the face with a dodgeball? Respawn... and catch it this time.

speaker: YOU
text: [cocky] Easy. Real life is just an obby... with checkpoints.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [ominous] But what if you respawned... too many times?

speaker: TIP
text: [glitching] T-TIP: Respawns used: nine thousand, nine hundred... and ninety-nine. [pause] That's... a lot.

speaker: YOU
text: [panicked] Okay, okay! Maybe I respawned a LITTLE too much!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [deadpan] Yeah. This needs some explaining. [pause] Let's go back... to the first checkpoint.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [storyteller] This is you. Twelve years old. Pretty smart. Pretty funny. [pause] And VERY scared of messing up.

speaker: TEACHER
text: [bored] Anyone? Seven times eight?

speaker: YOU
text: [whispering to himself] Fifty-six. [pause] It's fifty-six. [pause] ...But what if it's not?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You always know the answer. You just never say it. [pause] Because what if you're wrong?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [deadpan] It was fifty-six.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: But in games? In games, you're fearless. [pause] Because in a game, when you fall... you just respawn.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [deadpan] Real life does not have that feature. [pause] You checked.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: At home, there's Dad. He makes pancakes every morning... and the same joke every morning.

speaker: DAD
text: [proud] Why did the pancake go to the doctor? [pause] Because it was feeling a little... FLAT!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: There's your little sister, Bea. She's six... and she has never told a lie in her life.

speaker: BEA
text: [tiny voice, honest] Your hair looks like a mushroom. [pause] A sad mushroom.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [warmly] And there's Gary. Gary is a goldfish. [pause] Gary has seen things.

speaker: MOM
text: [warm, rushing] Bye, loves! Long shift! [pause] Remember, mistakes are how we learn!

speaker: YOU
text: [mumbling] Mistakes are how we get laughed at.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And then there's Ivy. Your best friend since kindergarten. She builds inventions. [pause] They explode. [pause] A lot.

speaker: IVY
text: [delighted, coughing] Fail number three hundred and twelve! Rocket sneakers! [pause] Lesson learned: never wear rocket sneakers... indoors.

speaker: YOU
text: [amazed] How are you HAPPY about this?

speaker: IVY
text: [cheerful] Because now I know one more way it doesn't work! [pause] Anyway! Big news!

speaker: IVY
text: [excited] I signed us up for the talent show! Friday! In front of the WHOLE school!

speaker: YOU
text: [horrified] The WHOLE school?! Ivy! What if I mess up?!

speaker: IVY
text: [shrugs, happy] Then you mess up! That's the fun part!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [deadpan] For you... it was not the fun part.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: That night, you couldn't sleep. The talent show was in four days. [pause] So you went where you always go when real life gets scary.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Mega Obby. One thousand stages. [pause] You'd been climbing it for three months.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Four thousand, eight hundred and sixteen falls. [pause] And nobody laughed. Nobody even remembered. [pause] You just... respawned.

speaker: YOU
text: [sighs] I wish real life had checkpoints.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Two in the morning. Stage nine hundred and ninety-nine. [pause] One jump left.

speaker: YOU
text: [whispers, focused] Come on... come on... [pause] YES!

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [calm] Final checkpoint reached. [pause] Exporting... to real life.

speaker: YOU
text: [confused] Exporting to WHAT?

speaker: TIP
text: [bubbly, fast] Hiii! Welcome to Real Life! I'm Tip, your tutorial! [pause] TIP: Step on the checkpoint to save your progress!

speaker: YOU
text: [backing away] You're a... talking pop-up.

speaker: TIP
text: [proud] A HELPFUL talking pop-up!

speaker: SYSTEM
text: Checkpoint saved.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Gary saw the whole thing. [pause] Gary told no one.

speaker: TIP
text: [cheerful] TIP: You can now respawn in real life! [pause] If you mess up, you go back to your last checkpoint. Time goes back too. [pause] And only YOU remember!

speaker: YOU
text: [skeptical] Yeah, right. That's—

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [calm] Respawning in three... two... one.

speaker: YOU
text: [stunned] I'm... back. In my room. [pause] And it's seven-thirty AGAIN!

speaker: TIP
text: [smug] Told ya!

speaker: DAD
text: [proud] Why did the pancake go to the doctor?

speaker: YOU
text: [quickly] Because it was feeling a little flat.

speaker: DAD
text: [shocked] How did you— That's a BRAND NEW joke!

speaker: TIP
text: TIP: You can move your checkpoint! Just carry the flag, and plant it wherever you want! [pause] TIP: And you can reset yourself anytime! Just open the menu!

speaker: YOU
text: [confused] What menu?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [amazed] Real life... had a pause menu.

speaker: YOU
text: [nervous] Uh... what happens if I press "Leave Game"?

speaker: TIP
text: [very quickly] TIP: Don't press "Leave Game."

speaker: YOU
text: [singing badly, opera] Ooooh... I am the KIIING... of the breakfaaast!

speaker: BEA
text: [tiny voice, horrified] Make it stop.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [delighted] And nobody remembered a thing.

speaker: BEA
text: [tiny voice] You're acting weird today. [pause] Weirder than normal.

speaker: YOU
text: [grinning] Bea... I think today is gonna be a GOOD day.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And it was. [pause] Because for the first time in your life... [pause] messing up didn't matter.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: So you took the checkpoint to school. In your backpack.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: Checkpoint saved.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Skateboard trick? Attempt one. [pause] Attempt two. [pause] Attempt twenty-three.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Attempt fifty-seven...

speaker: KID
text: [amazed] WHOA! Did you see that?! First try!

speaker: YOU
text: [smug] Yeah. First try.

speaker: TIP
text: [whispering] TIP: That was not first try.

speaker: TEACHER
text: [bored] Pop quiz. Twenty questions. No talking.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: A pop quiz? No problem. You read all the questions... [pause] and then you pressed reset.

speaker: TIP
text: [suspicious] TIP: That's... cheating.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [deadpan] It was one hundred percent cheating. [pause] You got one hundred percent.

speaker: COACH
text: [loud] Dodgeball! Let's GO!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Dodgeball? You'd already been hit by every single ball. [pause] So you knew where every single ball was going.

speaker: COACH
text: [stunned] Kid... where have you BEEN all my life?!

speaker: IVY
text: [suspicious] How did you know it was coming? You didn't even look!

speaker: YOU
text: [casual] Lucky guess.

speaker: TIP
text: [whispering] TIP: It was not a lucky guess.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: At lunch, you told a joke. [pause] It was terrible. [pause] Reset. [pause] Thirty-one tries later...

speaker: YOU
text: [confident] ...and that's why the cafeteria pizza has its own fan club. [pause] It's called "The Survivors."

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [proud] The whole cafeteria laughed. Somebody laughed milk out of their nose.

speaker: YOU
text: [glowing] This is the best day of my LIFE! [pause] Two hundred and fourteen times in a row!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Wednesday. Rehearsal. Ivy's big trick: "Elephant Toothpaste." [pause] A volcano of foam... out of a magic hat.

speaker: IVY
text: [dramatic] Ladies and gentlemen! [pause] From this ordinary hat, I will now pull out... a—

speaker: YOU
text: [flatly] A volcano of foam. I know.

speaker: IVY
text: [surprised] ...How do you know that? I didn't tell you that.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Every time something went wrong... you reset. [pause] And again. [pause] And again.

speaker: IVY
text: [laughing] Okay, okay, what if I sneeze in the middle and the foam goes—

speaker: YOU
text: [not laughing] —on the ceiling. Yeah. Don't do that.

speaker: IVY
text: [slowly] ...You're being so weird.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You lived Thursday four hundred and twelve times. [pause] Until the trick was perfect. [pause] Until YOU were perfect.

speaker: IVY
text: [hurt, quiet] You don't laugh anymore. You're never surprised. [pause] It's like you're not even here.

speaker: YOU
text: [quietly] I'm just... practicing.

speaker: IVY
text: [softly] You know how we became friends? [pause] Kindergarten. You glued your hand to my backpack.

speaker: YOU
text: [small laugh] For the whole day.

speaker: IVY
text: [sad smile] Best mistake you ever made. [pause] ...I miss that guy.

speaker: DAD
text: [proud] Why did the pancake go to the—

speaker: YOU
text: [bored] —doctor. It felt flat. Dad, I know. [pause] I know ALL of them.

speaker: BEA
text: [tiny voice] You're not fun anymore. [pause] Even Gary thinks so.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [quietly] Even Gary.

speaker: TIP
text: [glitching] T-T-TIP: Too many respawns make the s-s-save file... heavy. [pause] The world is starting to... l-l-lag.

speaker: YOU
text: [nervous] Lag? Real life can't lag.

speaker: MOM
text: [stuttering, glitchy] Good m-m-m-morning, sw-sw-sweetie!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Birds froze in the sky. The school bus kept teleporting back to the same corner. [pause] And Dad's pancake... just... stayed up there.

speaker: DAD
text: [confused, looking up] Huh. [pause] That one's... thinking about it.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And then... the whole street switched to low graphics.

speaker: YOU
text: [panicking] Why does everything look like it's from two thousand and six?!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And the respawns... started going wrong.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [glitchy] Respawning in three, two, one.

speaker: YOU
text: [hugging the pole] This is NOT my checkpoint!

speaker: SYSTEM
text: Respawning.

speaker: YOU
text: [tiny, underwater, bubbly] Hi, Gary.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: Respawning.

speaker: COACH
text: [confused] ...Are you a ball now?

speaker: SYSTEM
text: Respawning.

speaker: TEACHER
text: [deadpan] ...That was my birthday cake.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You respawned in Mr. Fig's birthday cake. [pause] To this day, nobody knows how.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [booming, alarm] Warning! Save file corrupted. [pause] Respawns used: nine thousand, nine hundred, ninety-nine.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [ominous] And then... everything you had ever undone... came back.

speaker: TIP
text: [glitching] T-TIP: Those are your fails. All of them. [pause] They never went away. [pause] They were just... saved.

speaker: KID
text: [laughing] Look! He fell off his skateboard like a HUNDRED times!

speaker: PRINCIPAL
text: [outraged] Why is a ghost throwing spaghetti at me?! [pause] AGAIN?!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Now everyone could see every mistake you had ever erased. [pause] All nine thousand, nine hundred and ninety-nine of them.

speaker: YOU
text: [miserable] This is my worst nightmare. [pause] Literally. I've HAD this nightmare.

speaker: IVY
text: [amazed, quiet] You fell fifty-six times... and you got back up fifty-six times?

speaker: YOU
text: [ashamed] Only because I could respawn.

speaker: IVY
text: [smiling] Still. [pause] That's kind of cool.

speaker: DAD
text: [stuck, looping] Why did the pan— [pause] Why did the pan— [pause] Why did the pan—

speaker: BEA
text: [tiny voice, looping] Help! Help! Help!

speaker: TIP
text: [urgent, glitching] TIP: The day is f-f-freezing! If it freezes... everyone gets stuck. FOREVER!

speaker: TIP
text: [softly, glitching] T-tip: Delete the save... and everything goes back to normal. [pause] But no more respawns. Ever.

speaker: YOU
text: [panicked] But the talent show is TONIGHT! What if I mess up? In front of EVERYONE?!

speaker: IVY
text: [warmly] Then you mess up. [pause] With me.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You looked at all your fails. [pause] Fifty-six crashes. Thirty-one bad jokes. One very surprised goldfish.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [softly] And for the first time... they didn't look embarrassing. [pause] They looked like... trying.

speaker: YOU
text: [determined] Okay. [pause] Delete.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [calm] Save deleted. [pause] Respawn... disabled.

speaker: DAD
text: [unfrozen, confused] —go to the doctor? [pause] Wait. Why am I outside?

speaker: TIP
text: [softly, fading] TIP: Last tip. [pause] Real life doesn't have checkpoints. [pause] That's what makes it... count.

speaker: YOU
text: [quietly] Thanks, Tip.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Lives remaining: one. [pause] Just like everybody else.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Friday night. The whole school was there. [pause] And every act before yours... was perfect.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Dad came. Mom came straight from her shift. [pause] And Bea made a sign.

speaker: PRINCIPAL
text: [announcing] And next... Ivy and... [pause] you! With "Science Magic"!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: No checkpoint. No reset. No pause menu. [pause] Just you... and four hundred people.

speaker: YOU
text: [nervous, whispering] Okay. One try. Only one try.

speaker: IVY
text: [dramatic] Ladies and gentlemen! From this ordinary hat, I will now pull out—

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And of course... you messed up.

speaker: YOU
text: [whispering, frozen] Reset... reset... RESET!

speaker: IVY
text: [whispering, grinning] Fail number three hundred and thirteen. [pause] Let's make it a good one.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: So you did something you had never done before. [pause] You kept going.

speaker: KID
text: [chanting] FOAM! FOAM! FOAM! FOAM!

speaker: MOM
text: [cheering, laughing] I'm sending this to the WHOLE family!

speaker: BEA
text: [tiny voice, shouting] THAT'S MY BROTHER! [pause] He's a mushroom!

speaker: PRINCIPAL
text: [foamy, deadpan] ...Best. Disaster. Ever.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You didn't win. [pause] The girl with seven bowling pins won. [pause] Honestly? Fair.

speaker: YOU
text: [laughing, covered in foam] We got "Most Unforgettable"!

speaker: IVY
text: [laughing] See? Told you! The mess-up IS the fun part!

speaker: DAD
text: [proud] Okay, brand new one! Why did the waffle go to school? [pause] To be more... well-rounded!

speaker: BEA
text: [tiny voice] Waffles are square.

speaker: DAD
text: [deflating] ...I'm gonna need a minute.

speaker: YOU
text: [laughing] Dad, that's the worst joke ever. [pause] I LOVE it.

speaker: YOU
text: [confident] Sixty-four!

speaker: TEACHER
text: [deadpan] ...Sixty-three.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You were wrong. [pause] And it was fine.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You tried the skateboard trick again. For real this time. [pause] Attempt one... [pause] Ouch.

speaker: YOU
text: [laughing, getting up] Attempt TWO!

speaker: IVY
text: [warm] Every inventor needs one.

speaker: YOU
text: [writing, smiling] Fail number one. Talent show. [pause] Lesson learned: totally worth it.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [whispering] Checkpoint saved.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [playful] Gary saw the whole thing. [pause] And now... Gary wants a turn.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [warmly] So... if you could respawn just once, what would YOU redo? [pause] Tell me in the comments! [pause] And remember... one life. Make it count.
